craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Broken-middle drunk-always; as-it-were inside. Rejected: (a) middle→center → killed: middle breaks. Read aloud: IN the-POW-er-EGG's-BROK-en MIDD-le … THIS, as-IT-were, MY in-SIDE.

lines: In the Power-egg's broken middle — world-saps — all I drink, always;
skull-cup-blood-pretext shown — this, as it were, my inside.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śāktāṇḍakhaṇḍamadhye viśvarasāḥ sarvam ahaṃ pibāmi sadā vyañjayasi narakapālagarudhiramiṣād etad iva me 'ntaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is drunk always? → Egg-middled juices drunk always; shown within as-if.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
